changes.old: Close shot on the flat Antarctic polar plateau, white snow meeting an unbroken horizon: one adult driver checks a distance-meter case on a stationary wooden sledge, clear austral summer daylight.
changes.new: Close shot beside a wooden sledge on flat white Antarctic snow in summer daylight: one gloved adult inspects an open wooden instrument case containing visible brass gears, a mechanical wheel and a plain round dial with an unmarked face.
